choices.content: Survey 200 students outside an eyeglass store
Survey only students who failed a vision screening

question.prompt: To estimate the proportion of students in a school who are nearsighted, which of the following methods gives the most reliable result?

solutions.explanation: Reliable estimation requires randomness and an appropriate sample size. Surveying students outside an eyeglass store or surveying only those who failed a vision screening introduces bias, while a random sample of 200 generally gives a more stable estimate than a random sample of 20. Therefore, choose C.
solutions.title: Compare bias and sample size
